scientific_integrity: The new negative half is proved by a fixed nonzero Dold numerator and infinitely many inert primes. The positive zero-translation half is explicitly attributed to Moss and Ward. No independent audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only nonnegative integral translations of positive even powers are classified; other polynomials and recurrences are not addressed.
External mathematical priority beyond inspected sources is not independently established.
Numerical checks are illustrative and do not substitute for the infinite proof.
title: Positive translations destroy almost-realizability of even-power Fibonacci samples
